text_copy.text:
2-minute read

A new era of LIFEPAK is here!

In Q2 2024, Stryker launched the latest product in the monitor/defibrillator space —LIFEPAK 35. It offers proprietary tools and technology, built on an intuitive, modern platform for advanced patient care.

 

Supporting and empowering healthcare providers

In today’s world, emergency responders and healthcare professionals are facing unprecedented challenges and staff shortages. In fact, about 75% of healthcare workers face mental health struggles like burnout, stress and anxiety.1 Providers are often busy trying to keep up with patient demand and they don’t have time or resources to invest in training. The LIFEPAK 35 allows trend monitoring to help guide caregiver decisions with its configurable events and connected capabilities for patient data,2 helping to support advanced patient care.

 

Built on a legacy of trust – reimagined for today’s healthcare providers

Using feedback from hundreds of customers around the globe and dedicating more than ten years to research, Stryker is excited to be able to offer an innovative monitor/defibrillator that supports the unique needs of first responders and essential healthcare professionals throughout communities. Built on a legacy of life-saving products and reimagined for today’s modern healthcare professional, the LIFEPAK 35 platform carries an established foundation of trust and reliability for healthcare professionals. Its slim, lightweight, ergonomic design,3 and large intuitive touch screen offers a customizable clinical experience that helps reduce cognitive burden4 while streamlining workflow. LIFEPAK 35 provides connected capabilities for patient data, from roadside accident through a hospital visit, helping to support advanced patient care.

From the roadside to the emergency room, our focus is on empowering you with the support you need to provide rapid, high-quality care under pressure. Whether it be on a crash cart or responding to a crashed car, the LIFEPAK 35 balances advanced clinical technologies and ease-of-use4 to help give you more control during critical events.

To learn more about this new monitor/defibrillator, visit the LIFEPAK 35 product page.
